deployRule: Build sanitized frontend payload with node scripts/build-frontend-publish.mjs, dry-run/deploy using .deploy/frontend-public only, and target frontend canister mprew-viaaa-aaaah-quola-cai. Backend target remains pifyq-raaaa-aaaab-agrqq-cai. Do not deploy project root or legacy paths.

legacyCanisterPolicy.note: Legacy canister fields are retained only for rollback/audit context. Do not deploy to, call, or validate production against these canisters during normal operation. Active frontend is frontendCanister; active backend is backendCanister.
legacyCanisterPolicy.retireAfter: Post-stabilization validation window and explicit retirement approval.
